verdict.rationale: Granola's docs publish a downloadable OpenAPI 3.1 document at docs.granola.ai/api-reference/openapi.json. It covers the /v1 endpoints for notes, transcripts, folders, spaces, audit, webhook-endpoints and legal holds, and it is advertised in llms.txt under "OpenAPI Specs". The probe 404s were at different candidate paths, not this one, so they do not contradict it. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation that the spec URL resolves and validates (the probe never tested the documented /api-reference/openapi.json path).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: Granola publishes a downloadable OpenAPI 3.1 document ("Granola API", server https://public-api.granola.ai; /v1 endpoints for notes, transcripts, folders, spaces, audit, webhook-endpoints, and legal holds), advertised in the docs llms.txt under "OpenAPI Specs".
